title: How long does delivery take?
answer: Inside Dhaka city, orders are delivered within 1-2 days. Outside Dhaka, delivery takes 3-5 working days. Orders placed after 6 PM are processed the next morning.

title: What is the delivery charge?
answer: Delivery costs ৳60 inside Dhaka and ৳120 outside Dhaka. Delivery is free for orders of ৳3,000 or more.

title: Which payment methods do you accept?
answer: You can pay with bKash, Nagad, Visa or Mastercard cards, or cash on delivery. Cash on delivery is available for orders up to ৳20,000.

title: What is the return and refund policy?
answer: You can request a refund within 7 days of delivery. Refunds up to ৳5,000 are approved instantly; larger refunds are reviewed by our team within 1 working day. Items should be unused and in their original packaging.

title: When will I receive my refund money?
answer: Approved refunds reach bKash or Nagad within 3 working days and cards within 7-10 working days. Cash on delivery orders are refunded to a bKash number of your choice.

title: Can I cancel my order?
answer: Orders can be cancelled free of charge until they are dispatched. Ask us to raise a cancellation ticket with your order number. Dispatched orders can be refused at the door or returned after delivery.

title: Can I change my delivery address?
answer: The delivery address can be changed while the order is placed or packed. Once the order is dispatched, the courier address cannot be changed.

title: I received a damaged or wrong item
answer: Report a damaged, wrong or missing item within 48 hours of delivery with photos of the product and the packaging. We will arrange a replacement or a refund.

title: Do electronics come with a warranty?
answer: Electronics carry the brand's official warranty, usually 6 to 12 months. Keep the invoice from your order email; warranty claims are handled at the brand service centre.

title: How do I track my order?
answer: Share your order number (for example HO-10021) and we will show the courier, tracking number and the latest status. You also receive an SMS when the rider is out for delivery.

title: Delivery during Eid holidays
answer: During Eid holidays deliveries pause for 3 days. Orders placed in that period are dispatched on the first working day after the holiday.

title: ডেলিভারিতে কত দিন লাগে?
answer: ঢাকা শহরের ভেতরে ১-২ দিনের মধ্যে এবং ঢাকার বাইরে ৩-৫ কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে ডেলিভারি দেওয়া হয়। ডেলিভারি চার্জ ঢাকায় ৬০ টাকা, ঢাকার বাইরে ১২০ টাকা।

title: রিফান্ড কীভাবে পাব?
answer: ডেলিভারির ৭ দিনের মধ্যে রিফান্ডের অনুরোধ করতে পারবেন। ৫,০০০ টাকা পর্যন্ত রিফান্ড সাথে সাথে অনুমোদন হয়। বিকাশ বা নগদে ৩ কার্যদিবসের মধ্যে টাকা পৌঁছে যায়।

title: কোন কোন পেমেন্ট পদ্ধতি আছে?
answer: বিকাশ, নগদ, ভিসা বা মাস্টারকার্ড এবং ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারিতে পেমেন্ট করা যায়। ২০,০০০ টাকা পর্যন্ত অর্ডারে ক্যাশ অন ডেলিভারি পাওয়া যায়।
